info.title: v2.discount.update_discount_item
info.description: Use this api to update items of the discount promotion.

post.description: Use this api to update items of the discount promotion.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: discount_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a discount activity.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an item.

parameters.name: item_list
parameters.description: The items selected to this discount. You can update at most 50 items per call.

parameters.name: item_promotion_price
parameters.description: The discount price of the item.

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a variation of an item. If there is no variation of this item, you don't need to input this param. Dafault is 0.

parameters.name: model_list
parameters.description: The models selected to this discount.

parameters.name: model_promotion_price
parameters.description: The discount price of the item.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: purchase_limit
parameters.description: The max number of this product in the promotion price.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
